outcome: Incidence of IVF in late preterm infants
cohort: Late preterm infants (34-36 weeks and 6 days gestational age)
finding: Late preterm infants conceived through IVF had a higher rate of cesarean delivery but lower rates of respiratory distress syndrome and prolonged neonatal intensive care unit stay compared to naturally conceived infants.
mod_finding: 100% of late preterm infants conceived by IVF were delivered by C-section compared to 44.5% of those conceived spontaneously.
